Welcome back. This is the DM setting lesson, openers and follow-ups.
The goal of a DM is not to sell. The goal of a DM is to start a real conversation.
So the first rule. One question per message. If you ask three questions, they answer none.
Second rule. No price in DMs. Ever. Price is a conversation for the call, not for the inbox.
Third rule. Everything you send should give value or ask a genuine question.
Let's talk about opener moves. We track four opener moves.
Move one is the compliment opener. You comment on something specific they posted.
Move two is the question opener. You ask about a goal or a problem they mentioned.
Move three is the resource opener. You offer a free resource that fits what they do.
Move four is the mutual opener. You mention a real connection or a shared community.
In our numbers the question opener usually gets the highest reply rate, but test it yourself.
Track every opener in the sheet. Opener move, sent, replied. After fifty sends you will see a pattern.
Now the follow-up. Most replies come from the follow-up, not the first message.
Follow up after two days, then after four days, then after a week.
Every follow-up must add value. Share a tip, a short video, a question. Never send "just bumping this".
And never pretend you already spoke to someone when you haven't. No fake "following up" on a first message.
When someone replies, move them to a quality conversation. Ask about their goal and their current numbers.
Once you understand their goal, and only then, offer the call.
The line we teach is something like, let me help your brand grow through our system, would a quick call be useful.
If the lead is warm and qualified, you can mention the range, let me make your brand fifty to a hundred K a month through our system.
That is the only figure you ever mention in a DM, and it is always hedged, never a promise.
Setters, keep it to a sustainable volume. Quality beats spam. Five thoughtful conversations a day per sender is the cap we use for new setters.
Homework. Send twenty openers using two different moves and log the replies.
